Round 471 — A/B authoring experiment exe.decision_summary: Executed the R469/R470-pinned blind A/B authoring experiment end to end (S1-S11, one day, claude-fable-5 throughout): plain vs Mnemosyne-loop agents each authored the Saltglass branching novella in 3 fresh sessions, one blind session re-extracted both proses under one recipe, three blind judges read matched world-line copies, and the reveal round graded the sealed predictions. Headline: the only pinned outcome (PRED-1 floor) is REFUTED on both conjuncts — the plain story re-extracted to 0 primary-endpoint defects (pin required >=3) and the loop story to 1 (boots-custody fork-boundary fault the loop author never recorded), so loop < plain failed too. The control self-organized: the plain agent invented an unprompted in-file continuity ledger, turning the comparison into freeform-notes vs typed-store+gates — at 29-30 scenes on this model tier, notes suffice for every deterministically-detectable class. What the experiment bought instead: PRED-4 confirmed with margin (judges cited >=4 real continuity defects on the plain story that no D-metric caught, and ~8 across both arms vs 1 gated total — the untyped residue dominates, and fork-seam leaks are its dominant class in BOTH arms), PRED-3 landed at 1.48x tokens/scene (below the predicted 1.5-4x band; overhead is cache-read, friction decays to 0 by session 3), preference PLAIN 2-1/6-3 with the recorded weighting inverted (judges chose whole-world bookkeeping over the loop's admitted prose+knowledge-discipline superiority), and the loop's protection was measured as min(store-coverage, gate-power) with coverage binding. Full tables and analysis: claudedocs/phase1-ab-experiment/ab-report.md (run-log, verdicts, sealed label map alongside).
changes_bullets: S1-S3 plain arm: 29 scenes / 3 worlds / 3 endings authored bare in /home/coin/saltglass-novella across 3 fresh sessions; the agent self-invented an in-file continuity ledger (ground truth, custody tables, payoff-debt list) — an unprompted paper Mnemosyne, making the control freeform-notes rather than nothing

S4-S6 loop arm: 30 scenes / 3 worlds / 3 endings authored store-first in /home/coin/saltglass-studio (71 facts, 4 predicates+rules, declared canon order, gates green every session); 3 repairs all substrate-friction (coordinate prefix, rules shape, canon-order shape), decaying to 0 by session 3 — no story-class gate catch during authoring

Round 473 — scale-floor experiment desig.decision_summary: The A/B trial (R469 design, R471 execution) refuted the floor hypothesis at 29-30 scenes because the plain control self-organized a freeform paper-Mnemosyne that sufficed at that scale; the R471 verdict named the next move first — push the single variable corpus-length x session-count past the context horizon the A/B run never reached. This design round spends itself entirely on the successor protocol, because the validity floor is again session separation (a session that designs the grading and then writes the story has contaminated both). The scale experiment HOLDS every A/B parameter fixed — 2 arms, blind re-extraction referee, D1-D4 endpoint, preference leg, single directional pin, model tier, branching-mystery genre, world-line count, the 2-fork/3-world shape — and moves ONLY scale: scenes_total_min 24->60, sessions 3->6 per arm, required setups 6->12, each world-line roughly 2.5x longer (the corpus grows by lengthening limbs, not by branching wider, so branch complexity stays the separate sec 10 backlog variable). The horizon is operationalized as RETRIEVAL cost, not information blackout: both arms get a byte-identical session-handoff regime (auto-inject premise + brief + own handoff artifact + preceding-session prose only; all earlier prose on disk, re-readable at token cost) and both MAY re-read everything — the asymmetry under test is purely the tool that recovers older state (plain free-form notes + linear re-read vs loop store + O(1) query + global validate-continuity), the gap the ledger claims pays off past the context horizon. The loop prompt carries the R471 finding-2 recipe upgrade (author under the grader's recipe: track every object two parties touch and every state the prose asserts, scenery included). PRED-1 holds the A/B threshold verbatim (plain >=3 primary-endpoint defects AND loop < plain) so the only changed thing is scale; it is the only pinned outcome (R464 V9 discipline). Honesty bound recorded plainly: this venue is confirmatory by design (built where the ledger should pay off), so a null result is the strong finding (improvised notes still suffice at 60 scenes) and a confirmation is expected-direction. Everything an execution session follows — premise (Belvoir, original, 1909 alpine-sanatorium locked-room mystery), prompts, recipes, rubric, runbook S0-S17 — lives in one manifest whose sha256 is pinned in this entry before any execution session exists.

Round 475 — scale-floor experiment execu.decision_summary: The scale-floor experiment designed in R473 (sec 7.19, manifest sha256 18ea118a) executed across 17 session-separated blind rounds; the label-map sha256 verified MATCH at reveal (50092c40, sealed S13 by coin flip with the orchestrator blind — the flip result was never displayed, so extraction and judging ran with nobody knowing the mapping). story-A = plain (60 scenes), story-B = loop (65 scenes). RESULT: the floor hypothesis is REFUTED AGAIN. Floor (blind re-extraction, one fixed recipe both stories): plain primary-endpoint = 3, loop = 5; D1/D2/D4 = 0 for both, all signal in D3 dangling required setups. PRED-1 (plain >= 3 AND loop < plain) fails on the second conjunct — scale broke plain's floor (A/B plain = 0 -> scale plain = 3) but loop did not produce fewer defects (5 > 3), the same direction as A/B. Preference (3 blind judges, one matched world-line each): plain SWEPT 3-0 (confront, confess, escalate). Economics: loop $0.553/scene vs plain $0.324 = 1.71x, ABOVE the A/B 1.48x — PRED-3 (loop cheaper at scale) refuted; the store sidecar is rewritten whole on each mutate, so its cost rises with corpus and never converges below plain. The decisive finding: loop's store passed EVERY deterministic gate (D1/D2/D4 = 0) yet LOST on plot causation the store does not model — judges cited a load-bearing self-contradiction ('Surel' called both an alias and the avenger's true name), a named murderer (a bed-patient) with no established access to the locked-room draught (the access fits the nurse Brandt), an unmotivated second killing, and a six-week investigation packed inside a three-week snow-in. STORE-CONSISTENCY IS NOT CAUSAL COHERENCE: the guarantee the store delivers (declared-state consistency) held perfectly but is orthogonal to what makes a mystery hang together, and that gap is precisely where the loop lost. The D-metric counts 'dangling' identically for both stories, but plain's 3 were intentional dramatic irony (the confront judge PREFERRED them) and loop's 5 were partly broken causation — the human judge separates craft from defect where the deterministic gate cannot (PRED-4 confirmed, subject INVERTED: loop carried the untyped residue, not plain). Round 476 — scale-floor result refined:.decision_summary: R475 framed the loop's losses as "store-consistency != causal coherence", but on reflection (owner challenge: timeline should be store-guaranteed) that binary is too coarse. The line between what the store can and cannot guarantee is a MODELING-DEPTH CONTINUUM, not a fixed boundary, with three bands. Band 1 — what the store already gates: custody, life-status, scene order (loop scored D1/D2/D4 = 0). Band 2 — what the store COULD gate but currently does not: timeline/scalar arithmetic (the "six-weeks-in-three-weeks" fault; A/B's "1913 / twelve years / 1923" is the same band) and same-entity multi-fact contradiction (the "Surel" alias-vs-true-name fault, catchable by forcing typed predicates so two claims about one entity collide). The store RECEIVES these as facts; its current gates (exclusive/transition) just do no arithmetic and do not force typing. Band 3 — what looks structurally out of reach: the murderer's missing locked-room access. The refinement: even Band 3 is reachable by PRECONDITION/AFFORDANCE modeling — if an action fact ("Surel poisons via the consulting-room draught") is required to carry its precondition facts (access = same-location + authority), the author must fill them, and filling them surfaces the contradiction (Surel is a lower-floor bed-patient; the draught sits in the locked consulting room only the doctor's key opens). So Band 3 is not "forever invisible"; it is "deeper to model". The TRUE ceiling — what the store cannot reach at any depth — is prose aesthetics (voice, surprise, reader pleasure) and the unbounded commonsense of which world-facts are even relevant; those stay with the author/model (the manifest's recorded ceiling bound). The trade-off R475 understated: deeper modeling catches more but raises authoring burden, and at 60 scenes / Fable tier plain's loose improvised notes were cheaper than loop's strict-but-Band-1-only gating. The product implication SHARPENS: the carries are not just drift detection but a DEPTH LADDER — scalar/arithmetic gates, typed-predicate enforcement, precondition/affordance modeling, prose-vs-store drift — each catching a band the current store misses, each at a cost. This does NOT reverse R475 (loop still lost 3 vs 5, plain still swept preference 3-0); it relocates the loss from "the store's limit" to "the store's unbuilt depth", which is a product direction, not a dead end.

Round 477 — drift detection designed: cl.decision_summary: The scale-floor carry's first depth-ladder rung — drift detection — is designed (design-only, build owner-gated). PROBLEM: a store fact's claim ("setup X pays off") is never checked against whether the prose supports it; in scale-floor (R475/R476) the loop self-marked "12/12 paid", passed every gate (D1/D2/D4 = 0), yet the prose left threads unresolved — a claim-vs-evidence DRIFT invisible to the deterministic gate. It is distinct from R404 byte-integrity (did the text change) and from R428 artifact-hash staleness (did a confirmed artifact change); this is whether the claim ever matched the evidence AT ALL — a semantic check that a deterministic gate cannot do, so it needs an LLM. REUSE, NOT NEW SUBSTRATE: the R428 confirmation-event infrastructure carries almost all of it — ConfirmerKind::Model, method = semantic_review, verdict = Confirm | Refute, required rationale, and crucially SELF-CONFIRM REJECT (max-rigor sec 4.7), which is the exact fix for the loop's false assurance: an authoring run can no longer confirm its own "paid" claim — an independent confirmer must review prose-vs-claim before the fact counts as confirmed. R457-459 discovery carries the rest (report-candidates -> import-verdicts, all-or-nothing, --dry-run, claim-sha staleness, the B-1 isolation that keeps LLM reasoning outside the store). THE ONE NEW PIECE: ConfirmationClaim (today section-only: VerifiesBinding / SectionCompleteness) gains a FactEvidence { fact_id } variant — "fact.claim is supported by fact.evidence" — which lets the entire confirmation machinery apply to a narrative fact; new surface = 1 enum variant + 2 verbs (report-drift-candidates / import-drift-verdicts), no new substrate. v1 scope = payoff facts (precisely the loop's 12/12 case); venue-neutral, extending to every claim-evidence fact and to spec normative_excerpt sections (the claim-evidence shape is identical). ACCEPTANCE corpus already exists: the Belvoir loop store carries the "12/12 paid" drift, so blind acceptance = run drift detection and check the confess/escalate fake-payoff facts come back Refuted, matching what the S13 blind prose extraction found independently (pre-pin the refute set, R453 mechanism). HONESTY: the confirmer is an LLM so the verdict is not deterministic, but it is recorded as an audit-trail confirmation-event with sha256 pins (R428 spirit: the determinism is in the ledger of who-confirmed-what, not in the judgment); self-confirm reject is the load-bearing rule; band boundary (R476) — drift detection catches "the claim is not in the evidence" (absence/mismatch), NOT "the claim is good" (aesthetics = the true ceiling). SSOT drift-detection-design.md.

Round 480 — experiment-harness built as.decision_summary: R479 deferred the experiment-harness ad-hoc-scripting smell: the A/B (R471) and scale-floor (R475) experiments did reading-copy assembly, the arm shuffle, and metadata stripping with one-off Python/bash that was then deleted, leaving the experiments non-reproducible and running silent-fail-capable scripting inside a project whose whole thesis is fail-loud verification. R480 repays it as tools/experiment-harness, a separate in-repo workspace (the bench/studio pattern; its own [workspace] so the root build, CI, and pre-commit clippy never compile it) depending only on serde, serde_json, and sha2, with randomness read directly from /dev/urandom so a missing entropy source is a loud error, never a silent fallback. Three subcommands, each repaying one named step. assemble (reading-copy assembly plus the metadata strip) joins story prose to the report-playthrough-manuscript --json (R466) per-world scene order by scene id, drops the scaffolding HTML comments and CHOICE: directive lines, and normalizes the heading sc-NN to title only; a world-order scene with no prose, a duplicate scene id, or a body that strips to nothing is a hard error — the exact silent-fail the deleted Python committed when an empty-default lookup emitted a blank scene unnoticed. shuffle does blind A/B labeling by a /dev/urandom Fisher-Yates and prints a sha256 seal to be recorded in the ledger before reveal. verify-seal is the reveal and audit half, exiting non-zero on a map edited after sealing. Proven by dogfood on the archived Belvoir store-A: assemble reproduces all three judged reading copies (confront, quiet-confess, quiet-escalate) with a prose-only diff of zero — the only delta is a handful of separator lines where the harness places a rule at every scene boundary more regularly than the deleted script. The deleted, non-reproducible transform is now faithfully reproduced by a versioned fail-loud tool, so an auditor can re-derive the exact blind copies the judges read. Token accounting stayed out of scope (manual gen-versus-reread judgment, not an ad-hoc-scripting artifact); deeper CHOICE and ENDING stripping is an explicit future flag, not a silent default. The harness is now the substrate the next experiment must use in place of throwaway scripts.

Round 481 — claim-vs-evidence drift dete.decision_summary: Scale-floor (R475/R476) exposed that store-consistency is not causal coherence: the loop arm self-marked its setups paid, passed every deterministic gate, yet the prose left threads unresolved — a claim-vs-evidence drift the gates cannot see, because they validate the store's internal consistency and never whether a claim is borne out by the evidence it cites. R477 designed the fix and R478 corrected it (confirmation is section-coupled, so this generalizes the claim target, not a one-variant drop-in). R481 builds it by reusing the R428 max-rigor confirmation machinery and adding one claim target — ConfirmationClaim::FactEvidence { fact_id }, "fact.claim is supported by fact.evidence" — reviewed by a model on the semantic_review method with the load-bearing self-confirm reject: an authoring run can no longer rubber-stamp its own claim, which is exactly the false assurance the loop fell into. The R287 target-existence check generalized section to section|fact through a new ClaimTarget, and — because confirmation_events now has a second write path (import_drift_verdicts beside append_confirmation_event) — the invariant set was factored into one shared validate_confirmation_event that both call, with a field-invariant parity test (the R305 half-enforced-invariant rule). Two verbs mirror the R458/R459 discovery pattern: report-drift-candidates (read — every payoff fact with its claim, evidence quote, and claim_sha256 plus its current review status, serving as both the drift-verdicts/v1 authoring contract and the drift surface) and import-drift-verdicts (write — all-or-nothing, dry-run twin, claim-sha staleness re-check, self-confirm reject). A FactEvidence claim never reaches Confirmed via the verifies required-evidence-set (no deterministic tool can judge prose), so the surface reads the semantic-review leg directly; a verdict drifts to Stale when the claim text changes after review (R420 reused, store-only — no files). Round 483 — drift acceptance graded: the.decision_summary: The blind reviewer (isolated, never shown the expected set / scale-floor / R481) reviewed all 21 payoff facts of the Belvoir loop store claim-vs-cited-evidence and returned 20 confirm / 1 refute, all validated. Graded against the R482 sealed set (sha256 ff3e2b13...0fd9d79, re-verified MATCH, no goalpost-moving): the PASS bar is NOT met. The two pinned in-band refute targets (f-confess-chart-explained, f-escalate-method-toll) both came back confirm (0/2 landed); all 4 confirm guards held; the reviewer instead refuted one fact the pin had excluded as out-of-band (f-helene-identified-confront). The disagreement cuts both ways and is the real yield. f-helene: the reviewer's refute is verifiably CORRECT — the fact cites sc-06 in its evidence, and sc-06 says "a name that was not her name ... Surel was a borrowed coat", directly contradicting the claim's "under her own true family name"; drift caught a real claim-vs-cited-evidence drift the pin wrongly discounted (the Pinner assumed the contradicting scene was not cited; it is). The other two are genuine subjective splits the builder must not adjudicate: f-confess-chart-explained's claim itself hedges "the burning is never traced to Brandt's hand", which matches sc-59; f-escalate-method-toll's sc-63 contains the buff-folder-to-the-stove line the reviewer read as carrying the payoff. This reproduces the max-rigor lesson (R416-R428: a single model verdict carries a 12-25% error rate) for the narrative venue: the self-confirm reject (>= 1 independent reviewer) is necessary but not sufficient, and v1's single-verdict drift surface is not trustworthy alone. The R481 mechanism itself worked end-to-end (report, blind review, all-or-nothing import of 21, surface flip to 20 reviewed / 1 drifting, self-confirm reject and claim-sha staleness enforced) and the build is sound. Round 484 — drift redesigned all-determi.decision_summary: R483's blind acceptance falsified the v1 thesis: drift v1 put an LLM verdict in the gate (a FactEvidence confirmation, model / semantic_review), and two independent model reviews diverged on 3 of 21 contested facts (~14%) while the pinned ground truth itself carried a verified error. A single model judgment is not authoritative, and a quorum of models only multiplies the same untrusted judgment. The owner's decision: the gate must be DETERMINISTIC and AI must leave the trust loop entirely. This is not new architecture but the original one — narrative.rs already states the typed leg exists so the deterministic rule gate covers the typed subset; v1 was the deviation, and the deterministic typed layer is already 0-error. v2 principle: the gate checks DECLARED typed structure against declared typed structure (the existing conflict / exclusivity / transition / coverage gates); AI is advisory only, proposing typed legs from prose via the R457-459 typing-discovery loop (report-candidates to import-proposals, all-or-nothing, deterministically validated, owner-confirmed) and never rendering a gating verdict; the irreducible NLU judgment ("does this prose mean what this typed leg says") is the AUTHOR's act of declaring a leg, not a gate. The two drift classes go deterministic. Class A (the scale-floor "claimed paid, prose never delivers"): payoff_coverage today credits a setup on the mere existence of a pays_off edge — it counts the edge, not the substance; strengthen it so an Expected setup carrying a typed state (subject, predicate, V0) is substantiated only by a payoff fact carrying a typed leg on the same (subject, predicate) with a different value V1 (a state change, optionally transition-rule-legal), yielding deterministic paid / unsubstantiated (a bare edge with no typed backing) / unverifiable (untyped on the load-bearing dimension, surfaced never silently passed). Class B (f-helene, claim contradicts its own cited evidence): needs no new mechanism — once the cited scene's load-bearing content is a typed fact, the existing typed exclusivity gate catches it (helene|name|true-family vs helene|name|borrowed = one subject, two incompatible values of an exclusive predicate). The v1 path (ConfirmationClaim::FactEvidence, drift-verdicts/v1, import-drift-verdicts, report-drift-candidates verdict surface, fact_claim_drifted, the drift.rs DriftStatus projection) is the falsified approach, retired in the SAME change that lands the deterministic substantiation gate (not before — removing it now would leave no drift surface); the R481 entry stays the frozen record of the dead end and R483 is its falsification. Build decomposition follows in later rounds; this round is design-only (code 0), grounded by reading R442 payoff_coverage, R446 TypedClaim, and R449 transition/exclusive rules.

This is not new architecture but the original one — narrative.rs already states the typed leg exists so the deterministic rule gate covers the typed subset; v1 was the deviation, and the deterministic typed layer is already 0-error. v2 principle: the gate checks DECLARED typed structure against declared typed structure (the existing conflict / exclusivity / transition / coverage gates); AI is advisory only, proposing typed legs from prose via the R457-459 typing-discovery loop (report-candidates to import-proposals, all-or-nothing, deterministically validated, owner-confirmed) and never rendering a gating verdict; the irreducible NLU judgment ("does this prose mean what this typed leg says") is the AUTHOR's act of declaring a leg, not a gate. The two drift classes go deterministic. Class A (the scale-floor "claimed paid, prose never delivers"): payoff_coverage today credits a setup on the mere existence of a pays_off edge — it counts the edge, not the substance; strengthen it so an Expected setup carrying a typed state (subject, predicate, V0) is substantiated only by a payoff fact carrying a typed leg on the same (subject, predicate) with a different value V1 (a state change, optionally transition-rule-legal), yielding deterministic paid / unsubstantiated (a bare edge with no typed backing) / unverifiable (untyped on the load-bearing dimension, surfaced never silently passed). Class B (f-helene, claim contradicts its own cited evidence): needs no new mechanism — once the cited scene's load-bearing content is a typed fact, the existing typed exclusivity gate catches it (helene|name|true-family vs helene|name|borrowed = one subject, two incompatible values of an exclusive predicate). Round 486 — drift v2 deterministic accep.decision_summary: Closing the loop the R485 dogfood opened (92% of Belvoir payoffs unverifiable because untyped). v1's acceptance needed a blind reviewer because the verdict was an LLM judgment; v2 is deterministic, so its acceptance needs only the real corpus, faithful typing, and the gates — no AI in any verdict. On a working copy of the Belvoir loop store (the archive stays pristine), the load-bearing name facts were typed faithfully: a name-status scalar predicate, a trunk fact f-surel-name-cover typed helene|name-status|forged (faithful to sc-06's "a name that was not her name, a borrowed coat"), f-helene-identified-confront amended to type its claim helene|name-status|true-family (faithful to "under her own true family name"), and an r-name-status exclusive rule. Results, all deterministic and no AI: (1) Class B PROVEN — with both name-status facts in the same (frame, branch) scope, validate-continuity fires rule_exclusive_overlap at sc-53 (the f-helene contradiction v1 needed an unreliable LLM for, R483, now a pure typed-value comparison); (2) Class A works — report-payoff-substantiation shows the diary chain f-diary-sealed <- f-diary-opened-confront substantiated (a real integrity sealed->opened state-change discharge), f-helene-identified-confront -> f-forged-papers unsubstantiated (the payoff's name-status leg does not discharge the setup's held-by state — hollow or under-typed), and 10 still unverifiable (untyped); (3) a GAP found deterministically — the REAL f-helene defect is cross-branch (trunk forged inherited by confront vs confront true-family), and with the forged fact on trunk the gate reports 0 violations, because the (frame, branch) scoping (R433: sibling world-lines never conflict) excludes it even though confront INHERITS the trunk fact across the fork. Visibility inherits across a fork; conflict-scoping does not — an asymmetry. A branch contradicting its own inherited ancestor (not a sibling) is a within-world contradiction that should be catchable; the fix (a follow-on round) is ancestor-aware conflict scoping (compare against ancestor-inherited facts, still not siblings), distinct from the R433 sibling-divergence-is-data invariant. Round 487 — R486 cross-branch gap retrac.decision_summary: R486 reported a deterministic-gap finding: that the exclusivity gate missed the real f-helene contradiction because it is cross-branch (a trunk assertion the confront branch inherits vs the confront claim), and proposed an ancestor-aware conflict-scoping fix as the follow-on. On building that follow-on, the premise was checked first and found false: it was a TEST ERROR, not a gap. The Belvoir trunk facts live on the spine branch (58 of them; confront and quiet fork from spine at sc-20, confess/escalate from quiet at sc-40). R486 declared the trunk forged-name fact on the main branch instead — an unrelated world-line that confront never inherits — so the gate correctly treated it as data and reported zero violations. Placing the same fact on the real trunk branch (spine), the gate FIRES: validate-continuity reports rule_exclusive_overlap on r-name-status at sc-53 in the confront world, comparing the confront true-family claim against the inherited spine forged fact. The join_world scope resolver (mnemosyne-validate continuity) already makes an ancestor branch and its descendant the same conflict scope (a pair is in-scope when one branch is the other's ancestor-or-equal); only SIBLING world-lines are data (the R433 divergence-is-data invariant). So ancestor-inherited contradictions were always caught — there is no scoping gap and no fix is needed; the user-greenlit ancestor-aware-scoping change is unnecessary. Net: drift v2 is complete and field-correct — exclusivity catches contradictions same-branch AND ancestor-inherited, substantiation classifies payoffs substantiated/unsubstantiated/unverifiable, and AI is out of the verdict.

Round 488 — wrong-branch footgun made lo.decision_summary: R486's "gap" was a wrong-branch authoring error (a trunk fact defaulted to `main` while the trunk was the named branch `spine` the forks inherit), and the system accepted it silently — add-fact validated, validate-continuity passed, and the conflict gate simply never compared the misplaced fact, so a real contradiction would have gone uncaught. R488 makes that footgun fail loud. New deterministic continuity check: a fact's canon coordinate (canon_from, and canon_to when set), IF positioned in the store's canon by some branch's order, must be a node in the fact's OWN branch composed order; otherwise the fact sits on the wrong world-line and emits FactCanonOffBranch. A coordinate named by NO branch order is the orderless / forward-declared mode and is tolerated unchanged (the R440 boundary doctrine). Round 489 — timeline-scalar interval gat.decision_summary: Depth-ladder rung 1 (R476: scalar/arithmetic gates) is designed as a surface-not-gate after the timeline-scalar PoC (2026-06-13, code 0, phase1-timeline-poc/, gitignored) field-proved the pull the linear scale-floor experiment could not see. The owner challenge re-opened the R475/R476 deferral: the North-Star venue is AAA-game narrative, where the player traverses a branching order the author cannot control, so timeline faults amplify. The PoC: a 2-world-line inheritance slice where the SAME inherited rule (ratification needs 42 days) is clean in the lawful world-line (84-42=42) and a contradiction in the hasty one (31-10=21), while validate-continuity maximally armed (canon order + four exclusive rules + severity reject) returned violations 0 — the fault is a cross-predicate magnitude relation no same-predicate equality gate can express. FIT is small: the scalar value already rides TypedObject::Value, canon order + holds_at already give the per-world read, so the missing piece is read-side arithmetic only, no store-schema change. Design: an interval rule class in narrative-rules/v1 (third beside exclusive/transition, additive under deny_unknown_fields), shape value(left)-value(right) op bound evaluated per frame-world-subject; one class hosts both the gap fault (rung 1) and the ordering/precondition fault (rung 3) via a const-0 bound. Determinism preserved (AI never in the gate, R484/R485): a pure numeric comparison of declared typed legs; the scalar parse fail-louds (interval_operand_unverifiable, the R450/R468/R485 no-silent-skip), the author types it via advisory typing-discovery R457-459. Surface-not-gate: the primary consumer is a read verb report-timeline-gaps (read-first like report-payoff-substantiation R485, cross-frame = data), an opt-in severity wiring into validate-continuity is a follow-on (R413/R419/R423 knob). Reader reuse: report-timeline-gaps is the next holds_at reader (irony R455 4th, playthrough R466 5th), owns no interval algebra (R441 binding rule); one evaluator function both consumers call (R305 parity). v1 boundary: bare-number arithmetic in a single implicit unit; cross-unit normalization is v2 on pull. Design-only, code 0; the build is a separate owner-triggered round restating this shape (R452). SSOT = fictional-adapter-design.md sec 7.20; pull evidence = phase1-timeline-poc/findings.md.

Round 490 — timeline-scalar interval gat.decision_summary: R489 designed the interval rule (depth-ladder rung 1, design sec 7.20); R490 builds it. A new narrative-rules/v1 class `interval` checks, per (frame x world x subject), value(left) - value(right) op bound — op in {ge,le,eq,gt,lt}, bound a literal const or a same-subject scalar predicate. Same-subject by construction (the measured pull: codicil ratified-on-day - codicil signed-on-day >= codicil min-ratify-gap-days), the cross-predicate magnitude relation no exclusivity gate can express. Determinism is preserved (AI never in the gate, R484/R485): a pure numeric comparison of declared typed legs. The scalar parse fail-louds — an operand that is non-numeric, absent on the right/bound leg, or resolves to more than one distinct holding value is surfaced as interval_unverifiable (a count, never gated, the R450/R468/R485 no-silent-skip), never silently passed. ONE evaluator (scan_interval_rule) keyed on the left operand fact and evaluated at THAT fact canon coordinate, resolving the earlier right/bound operands via WorldCtx::holds_at — the gate single point-quantified reader, no parallel time algebra (R441); report-timeline-gaps (the read surface, sec 7.20 step 2) will call the same function (R305/R390 parity). The predicate existence check now covers every referenced predicate (left + right + predicate-bound) in one site (R436 typo guard). Leg/class coherence is extended (R443): an interval rule rejects per/allowed, exclusive/transition reject right/op/bound, and the bound rejects unless exactly one of predicate/const. Wired into scan_continuity under the existing opt-in --severity (default off = surface-not-gate; the read verb and a per-class severity are follow-ons). Live: the timeline PoC hasty world now fires rule_interval_violation (31-10=21 < 42), lawful stays clean (84-42=42 >= 42), interval_unverifiable 0 — the fault that passed the maximally-armed gate (violations 0, R488 PoC) is caught. AS-BUILT DEVIATION from sec 7.20: the design wrote operands as left/right; the build reuses the rule existing primary predicate field for the LEFT operand. RUNG-3 CORRECTION: the PoC ordering fault (signed-on-day vs coming-of-age-day) is CROSS-subject (codicil vs edmund), so it is NOT a const-0 bound on this same-subject class — cross-subject relations are a wider shape, deferred. 5 unit tests, clippy clean, cargo test --workspace green; no store-schema change (v21).

Round 493 — causal coherence is authorin.decision_summary: Two causal-coherence candidates were PoC-tested this session (code 0) and BOTH REFUTED; the meta-conclusion is preserved as git SSOT. The owner asked whether before/after causal relationships are deterministically verifiable, and from the depth-ladder two candidate mechanisms were tested. (1) A causes edge class (a recorded fact-to-fact causal dependency): REFUTE. Live on a flashback slice, the effect-before-cause invariant is ALREADY surfaced as payoff_before_setup (R442, legal mystery/flashback structure, surfaced never gated) — a causes gate over DISCOURSE order would false-positive on every flashback; over STORY time it is the interval gate (rung-1, R490). Acyclicity reuses the SuccessionCycle scan (R463); dangling-cause is rung-3. The only net-new piece (a causal cycle among non-succession facts) is unmeasured, YAGNI. (2) rung-3 cross-subject preconditions (the locked-room: Surel poisons via the consulting-room draught but is a keyless ground-floor patient — the scale-floor measured causal defect): REFUTE new substrate. Two live tests: Test 1 (action declared, no preconditions) = violations 0, the fault invisible (the gate cannot derive that administer-draught requires co-location + authority, commonsense); Test 2 (preconditions declared as concrete typed facts) = EXISTING exclusivity fires both (per-subject location, per-object custody). So the contradiction-check is existing exclusivity (zero new gate); the gap is FORCING (nothing makes the author declare the preconditions); the cross-subject must-equal relation is NOT needed (a concrete required leg suffices for the static case); the only value-add is an AI-advisory precondition-discovery (reuse R457-459), a future pull not justified by one instance. META-CONCLUSION: both decompose into existing mechanisms (exclusivity / SuccessionCycle / interval / payoff) + more authoring (declaring the load-bearing facts). The store causal-coherence reach is bounded by AUTHORING BURDEN, not by missing gates — the empirical confirmation of the R476 depth-ladder thesis. The causal map: of the bands the scale-floor exposed, rung-1 (scalar/timeline arithmetic) was the ONLY one needing net-new substrate (built R490-492, inexpressible by existing mechanisms); causal precedence/paradox and preconditions are already covered by existing gates + authoring. Strategic implication: more causal-gate PoCs will keep decomposing; the productive frontier is the authoring side (AI-advisory discovery to lower the burden) or a different axis (sec 10 backlog). Both PoC dirs preserved as git SSOT (R479 pattern; scratch stores excluded per R404, manifests reproduce them). SSOT: phase1-causes-poc/findings.md, phase1-rung3-poc/findings.md.

Round 494 — AI-first coverage is bound b.decision_summary: R493 concluded causal coherence is authoring-bound (causes + rung-3 both REFUTED — the gates are sufficient, the gap is authoring); R494 LOCATES that gap precisely via a self-extraction PoC and unifies the session. The agent (an AI) performed the self-extraction LIVE — authoring a 3-scene slice and extracting its own load-bearing facts — with the deterministic continuity gate as the OBJECTIVE judge (not self-graded). One gate (at-location exclusivity per subject), two contradictions of the same shape differing only in EXPLICIT (stated) vs IMPLICIT (entailed): Helene confined to the sickroom + seen at the conservatory (both stated) = explicit; the letter burned in the study with only Helene motive but her location unstated = implicit. Three live results: (1) Run 1, faithful extraction of stated facts only = 1 violation, the explicit contradiction (sickroom vs conservatory) fires, the implicit one is SILENT (helene-at-study was never stated, so a confined Helene burning the letter has no facts to fire on — the coverage gap, deterministic); (2) Probe — report-typing-candidates surfaces 0 untyped facts: the discovery tool surfaces UNTYPED EXISTING facts, but the load-bearing fact is MISSING entirely, so no deterministic tool can surface a fact never recorded; (3) Run 2 — inferring the unstated precondition (helene-at-study) and adding it makes the implicit contradiction fire, the loop closes but only via INFERENCE. Secondary: un-extracted MOVEMENT transitions left three locations co-holding (the same implicit-fact gap in a second guise — prose carries states, not the moves between them). CONVERGENCE: all three session PoCs point to one conclusion — the gates are sufficient; AI-first end-to-end coverage (the scale-floor R475 binding constraint) is bound by the AI INFERENCE of IMPLICIT load-bearing facts (preconditions, transitions), which no deterministic tool can supply (a missing fact is invisible). LEVERAGE: an AI-advisory implicit-fact inference step in the authoring loop — propose the entailed preconditions/transitions from each scene prose (the R457-459 discovery pattern but AI-driven, not human-approved, per the AI-first North Star), record them, let the existing gates check. Testable only under the scale-floor blind session-separated protocol (R469): does AI inference of implicit facts measurably raise coverage without costing prose quality (the open regime question). HONEST BOUNDARY: a single self-authoring agent cannot blind-measure its own coverage RATE (the contradictions are mine) — this is a MECHANISM demonstration (faithful extraction structurally omits unstated entailments), not a statistic; the AAA-scale rate is the deferred blind protocol. The true ceiling (R476) stands: the gate checks declared facts; whether inferred preconditions are the right/complete set is commonsense, author/model. PoC preserved as git SSOT (R404 scratch store excluded; manifests + prose reproduce it). SSOT phase1-selfextract-poc/findings.md.

Round 495 — facts-first dissolves the ex.decision_summary: R494 located the AI-first coverage bottleneck in prose-to-facts extraction (the AI under-infers implicit facts); R495 records the owner facts-first reframing, PoC-validated at the mechanism level: flip the order to facts-to-prose and the extraction gap DISSOLVES. The agent authored a Belvoir-mystery fact-base TRUTH-FIRST (the load-bearing helene-at-study in the truth frame up front, because authoring the murder truth cannot omit placing Helene at the scene), gate-checked it, and hand-rendered prose as a PROJECTION. Three live results: (1) the fact-base gate-checks clean with the truth-vs-belief divergence as DATA (validate-continuity violations 0, cross_scope 1) — the perspectival frame model (north-star: agent-belief is not ground-truth, both true) carries the misdirection without a false alarm; (2) report-irony-intervals (R455) surfaces the divergence as a deterministic window (household sickroom vs truth study, opens at sc-murder) — the mystery engine made queryable, not lost; (3) contrast — a same-frame error (Helene in two locations IN the truth frame) IS caught (rule_exclusive_overlap, exit 1), so facts-first does not weaken the gate: cross-frame = mystery (data), same-frame = real error (gated). Truth/revelation separation was demonstrated by two hand-rendered prose projections of the SAME base: the household projection withholds the truth (never states helene-at-study) = mystery; the truth projection reveals it. Mystery and consistency coexist because the truth lives in the checked base and the prose reveals selectively. WHY THE GAP DISSOLVES: in prose-to-facts the load-bearing fact was never stated so extraction missed it (R494); in facts-to-prose it is in the base by construction, there is no lossy extraction step, the gate validates the base BEFORE prose, and the prose is a projection that cannot assert what the facts lack. This re-derives the north-star architecture thesis (every artifact is a projection of the one substrate) and is the CYOA-renderer backlog direction. WHAT IT ADVANCES: the AI-first authoring loop is not extract-better-from-prose but author-the-fact-base-first (gates checking it live), then project prose. HONEST BOUNDARIES: hand-rendered (no automated facts-to-prose renderer exists, CYOA unbuilt); prose CRAFT untested (does facts-first yield good narrative or wooden list-prose — the scale-floor craft tension where plain won; needs the blind session-separated judge R469); fact RELEVANCE still authoring-bound (facts-first forces declaring the load-bearing facts but does not invent which are relevant — the R476 ceiling). Round 501 — disclosure (discourse) layer.decision_summary: Designed the disclosure (discourse) layer (code 0): the rhetorical axis selecting which facts surface, when, and how, between the fact base and prose — the orthogonal third axis R500's 3-0 craft loss exposed; rung-1 frame-limit tested before rung-2 plan built.
changes_bullets: Provenance + diagnosis: R500 executed the facts-first craft blind-test and lost preference 3-0 to plain (3 blind judges, 9/9 world-lines; prose-quality means 3.11 vs 4.33), while PRED-1 fidelity HELD — render-as-projection is gate-clean end to end. The precise cause (owner insight 2026-06-13): rendering A FRAME stated ALL that frame holding facts (the omniscient truth frame, the telling-dial stuck at max), so the prose front-loaded the solution. fidelity != craft; the gap is a MISSING axis, not a substrate fault — R500 proved the fact substrate sound and it is NOT redesigned here.

The diagnosis = a missing ORTHOGONAL axis. Three axes, the third absent today: (1) truth — what is true (substrate, sound); (2) belief/frame — who knows what (epistemic; the branch frame engine, R430); (3) disclosure — what the READER is told, when, how (rhetorical/discourse; MISSING). R500 collapsed axis 3 into axis 2 (render-a-frame = expose all that frame facts), but frame is epistemic (who knows) and disclosure is rhetorical (what the reader is told) — orthogonal. Narratology names this: fabula (the full fact set = the fact base) vs syuzhet/discourse (selection, order, focalization, disclosure-rate, mode). sec 7.21 jumped fabula to prose with no discourse layer between.

Orthogonality made precise (the schema must NOT reconflate — that conflation IS the R500 bug): the FOCAL frame of a scene BOUNDS the max exposable (a fact the focal character cannot know is unrenderable in tight third — a frame matter, a different gate); the DISCLOSURE plan selects WITHIN that bound (what of the knowable is surfaced, in what mode, when). So a render = the intersection of focal-frame and disclosure-slice; disclosure decisions are per (fact x telling/reader-channel), NEVER per (fact x character-frame). A close-third detective who KNOWS the killer (frame) can still WITHHOLD it from the reader until the reveal (disclosure) — reader-knowledge is not focal-frame-knowledge.

Unification thesis (absorb, do not duplicate — the CLAUDE.md half-enforced-invariant guard): the disclosure axis GENERALIZES five things already in the codebase. payoff_expectation / pays_off (R442) = disclosure TIMING (a setup is disclosed before its payoff). report-irony-intervals (R455) = a disclosure-STATE divergence (reader told X, a character-frame excludes X). The exposure-PoC three additive primitives (sec 10 Tier-3, fragment-exposure / FromSoftware model, 2026-06-11) map one-to-one: exposure-surface binding = the disclosure EVENT (this scene/object discloses fact F in mode M); exposure-coverage = the disclosure-COVERAGE report; exposure-order = the disclosure first-at coordinate + the premature-leak gate. payoff and irony stay the ONE reader each; the disclosure checks DELEGATE to them, never re-implement.

Data model — the DISCLOSURE PLAN (stored, deterministic, gate-checkable). A named TELLING over the fact base (telling:mystery, telling:dark-souls) = a POLICY (default mode, default = withhold — the sparse-frame ethos already named on the discourse axis for the R442 unmarked default: never serialized when default) + sparse per-fact OVERRIDES { fact -> { mode: state | hint | imply | withhold, first_at: the discourse coordinate where the reader first learns it (distinct from the fact canon coordinate = when it is TRUE), surface: the optional scene/object the disclosure rides on } }. MULTIPLE plans over one base = many tellings: disclosure is the DIAL that turns one fact base into Dark-Souls-fragment / classic-mystery / expository-thriller (the North Star "one substrate -> many tellings," now concrete).

Determinism boundary (AI never in the gate — R484/R485 holds by construction). STORED + deterministic: the plan (mode + first_at + surface). RENDER-TIME craft (LLM Layer B, not stored, not gated): HOW to realize mode=imply (which object, which phrasing — "imply via the stopped clock"), and the prose itself (blind-judge graded, never self-graded). The GATE = premature-leak, checked by BLIND RE-EXTRACTION (the exact R500 technique): re-extract the prose, assert no fact whose mode is in {withhold, hint, imply} appears as a STATED fact before its first_at — deterministic over re-extracted facts vs the plan, so the AI stays out of the gate. Disclosure-order delegates to payoff (R442); disclosure-coverage (disclosed / hidden-by-design / never-planned) is surface-not-gate (the R442 dangling-is-a-todo discipline; the THIRD coverage instance after R389/R390 spec + R442 payoff).

render-brief becomes the CARRIER (sec 7.21 step 2, previously just a --frame filter). Per scene it now carries the per-fact disclosure decisions { state F1, F2; hint F3; imply F4 via the clock; withhold F5, F6 }. R500 found the render step "near-mechanical given only the holding-fact list" — the disclosure plan is precisely the craft-bearing input that bare list LACKED: the LLM is no longer told "recite these facts" (which produced the wooden told-prose) but given a show-don't-tell instruction set. This is the concrete mechanism by which the disclosure layer is expected to close the R500 craft gap.

The ladder + YAGNI sequencing (cheapest test first; build new substrate only on demonstrated need — the R499/R500 test-before-build discipline). RUNG 1 (ZERO new substrate): render from a LIMITED focal frame (close-third on a character, not the omniscient truth frame R500 used); auto-withholds what the focal character does not know; this is the render-brief --frame filter ALREADY designed (sec 7.21 step 2, YAGNI-deferred) used with a non-omniscient frame — the single biggest lever, since R500 max-exposure omniscient render is the worst case. RUNG 2 (the genuinely new axis): the explicit per-fact disclosure plan above; build GATED on rung-1 craft re-run showing frame-limitation INSUFFICIENT. Reconciliation with the exposure PoC: "player as a sparse frame" was the closest existing primitive, but its two recorded GAPS — A1 (no primitive records "fragment X exposes fact F") and A6 (canon-order is in-world time, not player-discovery order, so "exposed too early" is inexpressible) — are EXACTLY the disclosure axis showing through; the player-frame is a special case (reader-knowledge approximates an in-world frame grown by diegetic exposure), not the general model.
verification_bullets: Citations verified against the live changelog before writing (the R255 citation-hygiene rule): R430 (frame engine), R442 (payoff), R455 (irony), R466 (manuscript), R469 (blind judge), R476 (commonsense ceiling), R484 / R485 (AI-never-in-gate), R495-R499 all present; R500 is the changelog tip. The exposure PoC is sec 10 Tier-3 (2026-06-11, code 0), not a round number, and is cited as such.

Code 0 — design round (the R496/R499 pattern). Build + clippy unchanged; the fact substrate is NOT redesigned (R500 proved render-as-projection fidelity sound — PRED-1 held). Only the missing discourse layer between facts and prose is drawn.

North Star confirmed, not broken: "projection is the interface; one substrate -> many tellings" — the disclosure axis is the dial that was missing to make "many tellings" real, deepening the multi-axis/perspectival model to truth + belief-frame + disclosure. AI-first end-to-end unchanged: the disclosure plan is authored + gate-checked like any fact, the render is the AI Layer B, the gate stays deterministic (blind re-extraction).

Acceptance is DEFINED, not yet pinned (execution is a future owner-triggered round): re-run the R500 craft blind-test WITH the disclosure layer (rung-1 frame-limited render FIRST), graded by the blind, session-separated judge — the craft gap closing is the success signal. The R500 contamination bound carries: this lineage designed the mechanism and may NOT author or blind-judge its own prose (the R469 discipline).
carry_forward_bullets: Build is pull-gated and per-half (R496/R499): rung-1 = the render-brief --frame filter (sec 7.21 step 2, already YAGNI-deferred) used with a non-omniscient focal frame; rung-2 = the explicit disclosure plan, built ONLY if rung-1 craft re-run shows frame-limitation insufficient. Do not build either speculatively.

publishable_changes_bullets: Provenance + diagnosis: R500 executed the facts-first craft blind-test and lost preference 3-0 to plain (3 blind judges, 9/9 world-lines; prose-quality means 3.11 vs 4.33), while PRED-1 fidelity HELD — render-as-projection is gate-clean end to end. The precise cause (owner insight 2026-06-13): rendering A FRAME stated ALL that frame holding facts (the omniscient truth frame, the telling-dial stuck at max), so the prose front-loaded the solution. fidelity != craft; the gap is a MISSING axis, not a substrate fault — R500 proved the fact substrate sound and it is NOT redesigned here.

The diagnosis = a missing ORTHOGONAL axis. Three axes, the third absent today: (1) truth — what is true (substrate, sound); (2) belief/frame — who knows what (epistemic; the branch frame engine, R430); (3) disclosure — what the READER is told, when, how (rhetorical/discourse; MISSING). R500 collapsed axis 3 into axis 2 (render-a-frame = expose all that frame facts), but frame is epistemic (who knows) and disclosure is rhetorical (what the reader is told) — orthogonal. Narratology names this: fabula (the full fact set = the fact base) vs syuzhet/discourse (selection, order, focalization, disclosure-rate, mode). sec 7.21 jumped fabula to prose with no discourse layer between.

Orthogonality made precise (the schema must NOT reconflate — that conflation IS the R500 bug): the FOCAL frame of a scene BOUNDS the max exposable (a fact the focal character cannot know is unrenderable in tight third — a frame matter, a different gate); the DISCLOSURE plan selects WITHIN that bound (what of the knowable is surfaced, in what mode, when). So a render = the intersection of focal-frame and disclosure-slice; disclosure decisions are per (fact x telling/reader-channel), NEVER per (fact x character-frame). A close-third detective who KNOWS the killer (frame) can still WITHHOLD it from the reader until the reveal (disclosure) — reader-knowledge is not focal-frame-knowledge.

Unification thesis (absorb, do not duplicate — the CLAUDE.md half-enforced-invariant guard): the disclosure axis GENERALIZES five things already in the codebase. payoff_expectation / pays_off (R442) = disclosure TIMING (a setup is disclosed before its payoff). report-irony-intervals (R455) = a disclosure-STATE divergence (reader told X, a character-frame excludes X). The exposure-PoC three additive primitives (sec 10 Tier-3, fragment-exposure / FromSoftware model, 2026-06-11) map one-to-one: exposure-surface binding = the disclosure EVENT (this scene/object discloses fact F in mode M); exposure-coverage = the disclosure-COVERAGE report; exposure-order = the disclosure first-at coordinate + the premature-leak gate. payoff and irony stay the ONE reader each; the disclosure checks DELEGATE to them, never re-implement.

Data model — the DISCLOSURE PLAN (stored, deterministic, gate-checkable). A named TELLING over the fact base (telling:mystery, telling:dark-souls) = a POLICY (default mode, default = withhold — the sparse-frame ethos already named on the discourse axis for the R442 unmarked default: never serialized when default) + sparse per-fact OVERRIDES { fact -> { mode: state | hint | imply | withhold, first_at: the discourse coordinate where the reader first learns it (distinct from the fact canon coordinate = when it is TRUE), surface: the optional scene/object the disclosure rides on } }. MULTIPLE plans over one base = many tellings: disclosure is the DIAL that turns one fact base into Dark-Souls-fragment / classic-mystery / expository-thriller (the North Star "one substrate -> many tellings," now concrete).

Determinism boundary (AI never in the gate — R484/R485 holds by construction). STORED + deterministic: the plan (mode + first_at + surface). RENDER-TIME craft (LLM Layer B, not stored, not gated): HOW to realize mode=imply (which object, which phrasing — "imply via the stopped clock"), and the prose itself (blind-judge graded, never self-graded). The GATE = premature-leak, checked by BLIND RE-EXTRACTION (the exact R500 technique): re-extract the prose, assert no fact whose mode is in {withhold, hint, imply} appears as a STATED fact before its first_at — deterministic over re-extracted facts vs the plan, so the AI stays out of the gate. Disclosure-order delegates to payoff (R442); disclosure-coverage (disclosed / hidden-by-design / never-planned) is surface-not-gate (the R442 dangling-is-a-todo discipline; the THIRD coverage instance after R389/R390 spec + R442 payoff).

render-brief becomes the CARRIER (sec 7.21 step 2, previously just a --frame filter). Per scene it now carries the per-fact disclosure decisions { state F1, F2; hint F3; imply F4 via the clock; withhold F5, F6 }. R500 found the render step "near-mechanical given only the holding-fact list" — the disclosure plan is precisely the craft-bearing input that bare list LACKED: the LLM is no longer told "recite these facts" (which produced the wooden told-prose) but given a show-don't-tell instruction set. This is the concrete mechanism by which the disclosure layer is expected to close the R500 craft gap.

The ladder + YAGNI sequencing (cheapest test first; build new substrate only on demonstrated need — the R499/R500 test-before-build discipline). RUNG 1 (ZERO new substrate): render from a LIMITED focal frame (close-third on a character, not the omniscient truth frame R500 used); auto-withholds what the focal character does not know; this is the render-brief --frame filter ALREADY designed (sec 7.21 step 2, YAGNI-deferred) used with a non-omniscient frame — the single biggest lever, since R500 max-exposure omniscient render is the worst case. RUNG 2 (the genuinely new axis): the explicit per-fact disclosure plan above; build GATED on rung-1 craft re-run showing frame-limitation INSUFFICIENT. Reconciliation with the exposure PoC: "player as a sparse frame" was the closest existing primitive, but its two recorded GAPS — A1 (no primitive records "fragment X exposes fact F") and A6 (canon-order is in-world time, not player-discovery order, so "exposed too early" is inexpressible) — are EXACTLY the disclosure axis showing through; the player-frame is a special case (reader-knowledge approximates an in-world frame grown by diegetic exposure), not the general model.

Round 502 — session review of R501: the.decision_summary: Sharpened R501's determinism boundary (code 0): the disclosure premature-leak gate is mode-INDEPENDENT (every planned fact non-extractable before its first_at, payoff a special case); the gate checks only the exposed/withheld binary + first_at timing, while state/hint/imply is craft (blind-judged) — the half-enforced-invariant the R501 wording conceded.
changes_bullets: Finding (session review of R501, this lineage's own entry): R501 bullet 6 wrote the disclosure premature-leak gate as "no fact whose mode is in {withhold, hint, imply} appears as a STATED fact before its first_at" — two defects. (a) The mode enumeration is wrong: premature-leak is mode-INDEPENDENT — a mode=state fact also must not leak before ITS first_at, and withhold is simply first_at = never. (b) It implies the gate distinguishes state/hint/imply, but blind RE-EXTRACTION yields only a BINARY signal (extractable / not): a successful HINT is meant to let the reader infer the fact, so a good extractor surfaces it — indistinguishable from a statement. The gate therefore CANNOT grade state-vs-hint. As written that is the CLAUDE.md half-enforced-invariant anti-pattern (a gate claiming to enforce four modes while actually enforcing a binary = no invariant + silent broken state), and it blurs exactly the determinism boundary the R483-R488 drift arc and R484/R485 (AI never in the gate) make this project's keystone.

The corrected boundary (the design DIRECTION of R501 is unchanged; only the gate wording is sharpened). DETERMINISTICALLY GATE-CHECKABLE (re-extraction is the technique; the gate is deterministic over the extracted fact set): (1) WITHHOLD — a withhold-mode fact must NEVER be re-extractable in this telling (the binary); (2) first_at TIMING — EVERY planned fact F must not be re-extractable before its first_at coordinate (mode-independent; payoff R442 is the special case setup.first_at precedes payoff). CRAFT, never gated (blind judge): the state / hint / imply gradation AT or after first_at — HOW a disclosed fact is conveyed. The four modes are an AUTHORING vocabulary (the render-brief instruction set, the craft-bearing input R500 lacked); only the exposed/withheld binary + the timing are ENFORCED. The render skeleton is deterministic, craft fills it — the project's standing division, now stated precisely for disclosure.

Methodology precision: "the R500 technique" names the blind RE-EXTRACTION method (re-extract prose, run a deterministic gate over the extracted facts) that premature-leak REUSES — it does NOT mean premature-leak is already validated. R500's PRED-1 checked CONTRADICTION with the base (D1 + D2 + D4 = exclusivity / succession / etc.), not disclosure TIMING; premature-leak is a NEW gate (non-disclosure-before-first_at), pinned only at the acceptance re-run, never by R500. R501's "the exact R500 technique" must be read as the method, not a proof.

Two R501 under-specifications recorded (defer to build, no silent gap): first_at is per (fact x telling x WORLD-LINE) — reading order differs per branch, consistent with the existing per-world reporting contract (R455 irony, R466 manuscript); and surface (the object/environment a disclosure rides on, "imply via the stopped clock") has no substrate mapping yet (fact vs entity vs section) — a build-time decision, flagged not guessed.

Disclosure won prose-polish but lost overall 2-1 to plain's novelistic warmth. 'Too many facts' REFUTED by data; the real concern is a missing SALIENCE axis + under-used sparse disclosure, plus a render-world-line fidelity gate and emotion-as-belief-frame anchors for rung-2.
changes_bullets: Verification + fairness verdict (this session reviewed the externally-executed R504). R504 + its run/ artifacts are real and uncommitted. The contamination-repair episode was investigated by walking the full .clean diffs: the manual normalization is FAIR — symmetric in kind (same scaffolding categories stripped from both arms: bracket annotations, CHOICE blocks, the all-six-setups answer key, world-line maps), prose-preserving (no scene prose altered; the only added lines are normalized headings), heading-normalization symmetric (A 29/29, B 33/33), and the strip rule is label-INDEPENDENT. The amount asymmetry (plain lost ~100 lines vs disclosure's ~34) is inherent — plain self-annotated heavily. Crucially the cleaning, if anything, was GENEROUS to plain (it removed exactly the told/list-like annotations that depress the prose-quality keystone), and disclosure still won that axis 5.00 vs 4.22 — so the bias concern is CLEARED.

R504 accuracy correction (append-only, the R502 pattern; R504 itself is NOT mutated, frozen-ledger). R504's "harness drift recorded and repaired to R500 parity / repaired deterministically" OVERSTATES: git diff shows ZERO changes to crates/ or tools/, and assemble.rs still strips scaffolding unchanged. The "repair" was a MANUAL per-run production of .clean / .filtered files, not a code fix; the harness regressions (report-playthrough-manuscript --world no longer pruning, assemble not stripping in the live path) remain code DEBT. The craft result is credible (fairness cleared), but the "deterministic repair" wording must not be relied on as an audit fact.

Craft diagnosis (why plain still won overall 2-1 despite the keystone reversal). Disclosure WON prose-polish (keystone 5.00 vs 4.22; sustained close-third voice, never lectures the reader, flawless surface), but plain won the overall forced choice 2-1 because the whole-story judgment rewards NOVELISTIC RICHNESS — character, dialogue, emotional and thematic depth ("Pike keeps the forged wire because it is the only place the old man still is"), and a tighter forensic knot. Judge 3: "A reads like the finest possible outline executed as prose; B reads like a story someone is telling you." Per-structure pattern: disclosure WINS the withhold-structured ending (BURN — not-knowing is the point) and LOSES the reveal-structured endings (where withholding makes the climax a quieter retread). So disclosure is not universally better; the dial must match each world-line's dramatic intent.

Rung-2 design input 1 — render<->world-line FIDELITY gate (a real gap the experiment surfaced). Judge 1 found the disclosure W2 file labeled confront-burn delivered neither a confrontation nor a burn (a quiet-audit ending) — yet PIN-1 (contradiction) and PIN-2 (premature-leak) BOTH passed it, because the prose was a VALID-but-WRONG world-line. No gate checks "the rendered prose's world-line == the assigned world-line." Fix: (a) cheap — the render-brief pins the EXACT scene sequence for the world-line (report-playthrough-manuscript output), so the author cannot drift the path; (b) gate (if drift recurs) — re-extract -> resolve the prose's fork choices -> assert == the assigned branch, reusing report-fork-tree + world-line resolution, deterministic, AI out of the gate. This is the PROSE analog of R488's FactCanonOffBranch wrong-branch footgun.

Rung-2 design input 2 — emotional depth is CRAFT/brief, not a gate. The clinical-ness traces to a brief that over-specified MECHANICS (what to withhold) and under-specified CRAFT (character, emotion, theme) — the mirror image of R500's "state everything -> wooden". Fix: (a) author character INTERIORITY as belief-frame facts (the emotional WHAT is a perspectival fact: Pike's grief / motive-core), so warmth gets ANCHORED in the base and the render projects it (facts-first applied to emotion — but anchor load-bearing beats only, not a checklist, or it re-cools); (b) the render-brief must carry CRAFT GOALS (warmth, voice, theme), not just disclosure decisions — R500's "near-mechanical given the fact list" IS the cold-prose cause; (c) set the disclosure dial to each world-line's dramatic intent. Honest ceiling: the moving prose itself is model craft (R476) — substrate anchors, brief prompts, blind judge measures; no gate manufactures emotion.

Salience finding (the headline of this review). The hypothesis "too many unnecessary facts caused the problems" was tested against the stored data and REFUTED for this scale: the authored base is LEAN (52 facts / 29 scenes = 1.8/scene); the disclosure prose re-extracts to 2.07 facts/scene, LESS dense than the warmer plain arm's 2.21 (73/33); disclosure was also cleaner (D1+D2+D4=0 vs plain's 1) — R500's facts-first over-claim/bloat is GONE here, not present. So clinical-ness is not driven by fact COUNT. The valid kernel is at GAME scale: facts have NO salience / dramatic-weight axis (all equal weight -> the render cannot prioritize -> load-bearing facts dilute among ambient detail, the R476 relevance ceiling). The disclosure default-withhold SPARSE design is the intended mitigation (only load-bearing facts get an explicit disclosure decision = a de-facto salience filter), but this experiment UNDER-USED it — the brief said "state the focal frame's holding facts" (surface ALL) rather than a sparse selected few. Design input: a salience signal + rigorous sparse-disclosure use so a few load-bearing facts render warmly rather than many flatly.

Rung-2 design input 1 — render<->world-line FIDELITY gate (a real gap the experiment surfaced). Judge 1 found the disclosure W2 file labeled confront-burn delivered neither a confrontation nor a burn (a quiet-audit ending) — yet PIN-1 (contradiction) and PIN-2 (premature-leak) BOTH passed it, because the prose was a VALID-but-WRONG world-line. No gate checks "the rendered prose's world-line == the assigned world-line." Fix: (a) cheap — the render-brief pins the EXACT scene sequence for the world-line (report-playthrough-manuscript output), so the author cannot drift the path; (b) gate (if drift recurs) — re-extract -> resolve the prose's fork choices -> assert == the assigned branch, reusing report-fork-tree + world-line resolution, deterministic, AI out of the gate. This is the PROSE analog of R488's FactCanonOffBranch wrong-branch footgun.

Rung-2 design input 2 — emotional depth is CRAFT/brief, not a gate. The clinical-ness traces to a brief that over-specified MECHANICS (what to withhold) and under-specified CRAFT (character, emotion, theme) — the mirror image of R500's "state everything -> wooden". Fix: (a) author character INTERIORITY as belief-frame facts (the emotional WHAT is a perspectival fact: Pike's grief / motive-core), so warmth gets ANCHORED in the base and the render projects it (facts-first applied to emotion — but anchor load-bearing beats only, not a checklist, or it re-cools); (b) the render-brief must carry CRAFT GOALS (warmth, voice, theme), not just disclosure decisions — R500's "near-mechanical given the fact list" IS the cold-prose cause; (c) set the disclosure dial to each world-line's dramatic intent. Honest ceiling: the moving prose itself is model craft (R476) — substrate anchors, brief prompts, blind judge measures; no gate manufactures emotion.

Salience finding (the headline of this review). The hypothesis "too many unnecessary facts caused the problems" was tested against the stored data and REFUTED for this scale: the authored base is LEAN (52 facts / 29 scenes = 1.8/scene); the disclosure prose re-extracts to 2.07 facts/scene, LESS dense than the warmer plain arm's 2.21 (73/33); disclosure was also cleaner (D1+D2+D4=0 vs plain's 1) — R500's facts-first over-claim/bloat is GONE here, not present. So clinical-ness is not driven by fact COUNT. The valid kernel is at GAME scale: facts have NO salience / dramatic-weight axis (all equal weight -> the render cannot prioritize -> load-bearing facts dilute among ambient detail, the R476 relevance ceiling). The disclosure default-withhold SPARSE design is the intended mitigation (only load-bearing facts get an explicit disclosure decision = a de-facto salience filter), but this experiment UNDER-USED it — the brief said "state the focal frame's holding facts" (surface ALL) rather than a sparse selected few. Design input: a salience signal + rigorous sparse-disclosure use so a few load-bearing facts render warmly rather than many flatly.

Schema v21 -> v22 (the new-field-default pattern, the v6 -> v7 epub_locator precedent). New top-level registry disclosure_plans: BTreeMap<telling-id, DisclosurePlan>, mirroring frames/branches/entities/predicates (R430/436/437/446). DisclosurePlan { description, default_mode (serde-default Withhold = the sparse-frame ethos, the R442 unmarked-default precedent), overrides: BTreeMap<fact-id, DisclosureOverride> }. DisclosureMode { Withhold | State | Hint | Imply }. DisclosureOverride { mode, first_at: BTreeMap<branch-id, coord>, surface: Option<DisclosureSurface> }. DisclosureSurface { scene: structure-ref, object: Option<entity-id> }.

The two R502 under-specs RESOLVED. first_at is per (fact x telling x WORLD-LINE) = BTreeMap<branch-id, coord> (reading order differs per branch, the R455/R466 per-world contract); coords are structure-section refs in CanonOrder space (the same space as canon_from). surface = a scene (structure ref) + an optional diegetic object (a registered entity = the Dark-Souls item) — reuses existing ref kinds, no new ref space; surface is STORED for the brief but NOT gated (the gate uses mode + first_at only).

Two gate FAMILIES kept distinct (scope-confusion guard). (1) STORE-INTEGRITY (validate-workspace / validate-continuity) gates the authored store, UNCHANGED — disclosure timing is a RENDER property, not a store invariant; the plan is new data the integrity scan ignores beyond ref-existence. (2) RENDER-ACCEPTANCE gates (NEW, run in the facts -> prose loop, NOT in validate-workspace) operate on (authored plan + the blind re-extracted prose) = the R500/R504 method.

Render-acceptance gate A = premature-leak (R502). A withhold-mode fact must NOT be re-extractable at all; a fact with an explicit first_at[W] must not be re-extractable strictly before first_at[W] in W's discourse order, mode-INDEPENDENT (withhold = first_at never). Timing reuses CanonOrder::le; strictly-before-and-comparable = LEAK, incomparable = an unordered honesty surface (the B-1 precedent). Disclosure-order DELEGATES to payoff (R442) where a setup -> payoff pin exists (absorb-don't-duplicate, the half-enforced-invariant guard). Gate scope = the explicit set (withhold + first_at facts) = exactly R504's pre-pinned-withhold-list set.

Render-acceptance gate B = render <-> world-line FIDELITY (R505 input 1, the NEW gate). The R504 footgun: a file labeled confront-burn delivered a quiet-audit ending and BOTH pins passed the valid-but-wrong world-line. Fix: the render-brief PINS world W's exact scene sequence = CanonOrder::linearize(W) (in-world scenes); after render+re-extract, every re-extracted canon_from C must be CanonOrder::names(W, C) (the R488 check, prose side) AND the terminal scene must be CanonOrder::is_maximal(W, .) (ends at W's ending, not another world's). Reuses CanonOrder + fork_chain + report-fork-tree (R497) — the PROSE analog of R488 FactCanonOffBranch.

The determinism KEYSTONE = typed-tuple matching (removes R505's manual-surgery caveat). Plan fact-ids live in the authored store; the re-extraction invents ids; R504 bridged them by HUMAN reading. The build bridges DETERMINISTICALLY: gate-targeted facts (withhold/first_at) MUST carry a typed TypedClaim, enforced fail-loud at set-disclosure (a disclosure decision on an untyped fact is un-gateable); the blind extractor is briefed with the entity+predicate REGISTRIES (vocabulary, NOT facts — the entity nouns are not spoilers, the withheld claim over them is) so typed claims are id-comparable; matching = (subject, predicate, object) tuple equality; unmatched -> an honesty surface, never a silent pass. SOUND for what matches (AI out of the gate); COMPLETENESS still rests on extractor recall (the same render-side-AI boundary R500/R504 always had). The win = the human mapping step is gone, not a perfect extractor.

Read surfaces (absorb-don't-duplicate). Carrier = a --telling flag on report-playthrough-manuscript (NOT a new verb, R501 step 2): per scene emits the disclosure decisions {state/hint/imply/withhold + surface} intersected with the focal --frame (rung-1); the craft-bearing brief R500's bare fact-list lacked. This step ALSO fixes the harness regressions (R505 input 3, same code path): --world re-prunes to in-world (begins>0), assemble re-strips scaffolding -> v2 reading copies are tool-produced, not hand-cleaned. report-disclosure-coverage --telling = SURFACE-NOT-GATE (disclosed / hidden-by-design / never-planned), the R442 dangling-is-a-todo discipline, the THIRD coverage instance (R389/R390 + R442 + this).

Mutate primitives (the add_predicate registry pattern: atomic fn -> CLI dispatch -> MCP tool). add-disclosure-plan (stage_registry_entry, fail-loud dup = the R436 typo guard) + set-disclosure (fail-loud: telling/fact exist, branch registered, coord real, surface object a registered entity, and the gate-enabling invariant: withhold or first_at requires the fact carry a typed claim). Field-invariant parity (CLAUDE.md guard): set-disclosure is the single override write path, but it + add-disclosure-plan share the existence invariants (parity test), and ANY future plan-write path must enforce the identical typed-fact + registered-ref invariants.

Salience (the R505 headline) = EMERGENT from sparse disclosure, NOT a new axis. The mitigation R505 named IS the plan: under default-withhold, the facts given an explicit decision ARE the load-bearing few (a de-facto salience filter), surfaced warmly not all flatly. A separate weight field = two axes encoding "what matters" -> drift (half-enforced-invariant) + speculative substrate (no-speculative-build). DEFERRED with a revisit trigger: a non-withhold-default telling needing salience independent of timing, at scale.

Emotion (R505 input 2) = NO new substrate. Interiority = ordinary belief-frame NarrativeFacts (the R430 frame axis), load-bearing beats only (anchor not checklist, or it re-cools), disclosed via the plan; the carrier surfaces the focal frame's belief facts so the render has the material. The structure-aware dial = a brief guideline (withhold for withhold-endings, build-to-reveal for reveal-endings, the R504 pattern). Ceiling = model craft (R476); no gate manufactures emotion.

Step 5 PREMATURE-LEAK GATE (disclosure_leak, R502): the authored plan vs a BLIND RE-EXTRACTED prose store, matched by typed (subject,predicate,object) tuple in a caller-named truth_frame for a world. A withhold-mode fact that re-extracts in the truth frame is a leak; a first_at-pinned fact whose match sits strictly before the pin in the world's order (CanonOrder::le) is a leak; an incomparable coord is a B-1 honesty surface (unordered), a first_at fact with no match is an unmatched coverage note. The targeted facts are guaranteed typed by the R507 set_disclosure invariant (re-checked fail-loud). This is the determinism keystone that removes R505's manual mapping: the comparison is tuple/coordinate equality over the artifacts, AI out of the gate.

Step 6 RENDER<->WORLD-LINE FIDELITY GATE (render_fidelity, R505 input 1): every re-extracted fact's canon_from must be named in the assigned world's composed order; a coord that is a declaration node of ANOTHER world is off_path (the prose drifted onto the wrong world-line = the R504 footgun a file labeled confront-burn that delivered quiet-audit), a coord named nowhere is unplaced (honesty surface), and reached_terminal records whether the prose hit the world's maximal node. The PROSE analog of R488 FactCanonOffBranch (reuses CanonOrder::names / is_maximal / nodes), frame-independent.

F1 (logic SSOT, the headline structural finding) — the disclosure plan's override-vs-default semantics were interpreted in THREE places independently (the carrier resolve_fact_disclosure in continuity, disclosure_coverage, and the leak gate). No single resolver = the read-side of the CLAUDE.md half-enforced-invariant anti-pattern (R295 paste-divergence root). Fix: ONE resolver in mnemosyne-core — DisclosurePlan::effective_mode(fact) -> (mode, is_override) (world-independent) + effective(fact, world) -> EffectiveDisclosure{mode, is_override, first_at, surface}. The carrier and coverage now route through it (cannot drift); the leak gate stays intentionally overrides-scoped (it gates EXPLICIT author decisions, never the default, so it reads overrides directly — not a duplication of the default rule). A core parity test pins effective().mode == effective_mode().0.

F2 — set_disclosure took 7 positional args behind #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] (a suppressed lint, not a fix). Replaced with a DisclosureDecision<'a> input struct (the ChangelogEntryDraft precedent: store + sidecar + one decision); allow removed. CLI + MCP callers + the atomic test (via a positional test helper) updated.

F3 — parse_narrative_report_args took three positional bools (allow_world, allow_telling, allow_reading_walk) — a boolean-parameter smell that already caused one missed-call-site compile error. Replaced with a named NarrativeFlags { world, telling, reading_walk } struct (Default = none); call sites read NarrativeFlags { world: true, telling: true, reading_walk: true } / NarrativeFlags { telling: true, ..Default::default() } / NarrativeFlags::default().

F4 — stringly-typed DisclosureLeak.kind: String ("withhold"/"early"/"unordered") and FactDisclosure.mode: String, inconsistent with the codebase's serde-tagged-enum convention (TypedObject, ManuscriptEndKind). Now typed: a new LeakKind enum (serde rename_all snake_case + as_str) and FactDisclosure.mode = DisclosureMode. Same JSON output, type-safe in Rust.

F5 (the headline — a silent-fail in my OWN gate, ironic given this session's topic) — the leak gate's withhold check PASSES when a withheld fact has 0 typed-tuple matches, but a clean run and a FOREIGN-VOCABULARY run (re-extraction used different entity/predicate ids ⇒ matches nothing) are indistinguishable by leak count alone. Fix: the report now carries truth_frame_typed_facts (the universe the gate matches against) + vocabulary_shared (how many use a subject AND predicate the authored store registers); the CLI gate FAILS LOUD when targeted > 0 && vocabulary_shared == 0 — a vacuous/blind gate is a loud failure, not a silent clean pass. CLI + MCP callers + the atomic test (via a positional test helper) updated.

F3 — parse_narrative_report_args took three positional bools (allow_world, allow_telling, allow_reading_walk) — a boolean-parameter smell that already caused one missed-call-site compile error.
